validity.recommendation: Keep the row but check physical progress; the cited sources only report talks, a supply deal and an official statement.
validity.researcher_notes: The two cited pages are a bne IntelliNews piece (30 September 2024: plans a pipeline under the Caspian Sea) and TASS (17 January 2025: Putin says construction is underway, 2 bcm/y first, up to 55 bcm/y later). Neither gives a route, length or owner of a built line. The 55 bcm/y is a long-term prospect. Status Construction rests on an official statement only.

verifications.note: TASS of 17 January 2025 quotes President Putin: deliveries to Iran may start at up to 2 billion cubic meters a year and in future could reach 55 billion cubic meters a year. The sheet holds the 55 bcm/y long-term figure. It is a prospect and not a design capacity, and the first stage is 2 bcm/y. The article says a gas pipeline from Russia to Iran and does not use the sheet's name Russia-Iran Gas Pipeline; the match was confirmed by hand.

The article says a gas pipeline from Russia to Iran and does not use the sheet's name Russia-Iran Gas Pipeline; the match was confirmed by hand.

The bne IntelliNews piece of 30 September 2024 says only that Moscow plans to build a pipeline under the Caspian Sea, so physical construction is not shown by either source. The article says a gas pipeline from Russia to Iran and does not use the sheet's name Russia-Iran Gas Pipeline; the match was confirmed by hand.

The IntelliNews article of 30 September 2024 names the National Iranian Gas Company and Gazprom as the parties to a 30-year supply deal, and says Moscow plans a new pipeline under the Caspian Sea. It does not say who owns the pipeline and does not name the Iran Ministry of Petroleum. No other cited page states the owners, so the sheet values stay without a new ref. Nothing was searched outside the citations this pass.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: TASS of 17 January 2025 quotes Putin that construction is underway. IntelliNews of 30 September 2024 said the line was still planned. No newer citation. The sheet's Construction is kept at medium because the only evidence is an official statement and no source shows pipe laid.

cross_row_leads.facts: Worth an open-web search for physical construction evidence, route and owner of the Russia to Iran line.
